gloss_text: Rate your driver. How was your last ride?
Hi, I will call tomorrow evening. No rush, we will talk later.

Hi, did your number change? Just asking, reply when you have time.
I have put the groceries away, tell me when you reach home.
Hello, I am calling from the shop. Your order is ready, tell me when you will come.
Aunty asked whether you will come for lunch on Sunday. Reply if you can.

Hey everyone, does anyone know whose car got scratched in the parking last night? I did not see anything. Who is coming to Sunday's meeting? And did anyone post the expense list?
Bro, who is coming to play cricket this evening? I will be at the ground by six. Last time someone hid the ball, so bring it yourselves this time! Then should we go for vada pav? I am really hungry.
Hi all, we need to collect money for tea, 20 rupees each. The office party on Friday is also fixed, tell me if you have an allergy. And please reply now, not later.
Who is making poha in the morning? I will come at noon, no spicy food today! Do not forget two boxes like last time. If anyone took photos, please share.
Good morning everyone 🌞 Start the day by remembering God. Forward this message to ten people, they say good things happen!
Is this news true? Someone said water will be off in the society tomorrow. I am not sure, should we tell everyone? Please verify before forwarding.
Sending a photo of the Ganpati immersion, it is very nice. Send this message to all neighbours, everyone in our society should see it. Happy New Year wishes too!
All members are informed that the society meeting is on Saturday at 9 am. Topics: parking and maintenance costs. Please attend on time or send a representative.
Subscription collection starts tomorrow at six in the morning. We expect 200 rupees from each home. Suresh will have the receipt book. Those who cannot come should inform us by tonight.

Tomorrow there is a parent-teacher meeting at school at two in the afternoon. Class teacher Meenatai will meet you in class. Bring the new part of the notebooks. We will share next week's holiday details later.
Smoke is visible in building B and the fire alarm is ringing. Everyone come down the stairs immediately, do not use the lift. The fire brigade is coming, nobody should go inside.
There is a smell of gas. Everyone in wing B, open windows, do not press lights or switches, and leave. Police have been informed. Do not let children go outside.
Flood situation: drain water is entering the residential area. Residents of low-lying areas should move to a safe place right now. For help, contact the nearest relief centre.
Ramesh, a delivery agent, is at the gate with a parcel. Should I approve the gate pass? Reply yes or no.
Sunita, a domestic helper, is waiting at the gate. Press the button to let her in. If she is a guest you already approved, ignore this notice.
A person was seen on the door camera, standing near the steps. If it is a delivery, reply in the app. No danger is visible right now.
